summary: Direct access to Templar.environment is deprecated, removed in ansible-core 2.23; use Templar.copy_with_new_env() or pass overrides to Templar.template().
questions: My plugin modifies templar.environment, what should I do instead?
How do I change Jinja settings for one template call?

answer_card.title: Stop using Templar.environment
answer_card.answer_md: `Templar.environment` access is deprecated (removed in 2.23). Use **`templar.copy_with_new_env(...)`** for a new instance, or **`templar.template(value, overrides={...})`** for per-call settings.
